title: Repeated converged build and RSS after shared citation URL deduplication

measurement.scope: Complete converged LuaLaTeX compilation of the exact retained candidate source and media in a fresh directory; excludes Gramps UI and model-generation allocations.
binary_metadata_differences_observed: The PDF trailer ID and creation/modification metadata vary between converged builds.

comparison.interpretation: Two builds of the candidate source converge and match the audited output metrics. Their 16.836-second range is 4.05% of their median. The comparison against a single historical control is indicative only; the control was generated from a different source and does not establish a stable speed or RSS reduction.

measurement_notes: On macOS, ru_maxrss reports bytes and records the maximum resident set size among waited child processes; LuaLaTeX is the dominant child.
The ps process sampler runs every second and can miss short-lived peaks; its maximum was 1,067,237,376 bytes over 395 LuaLaTeX samples.
The temporary workspace monitor samples logical file sizes every 100 ms and can miss brief peaks.
Per-pass durations were not captured for this repeat.
